text_block_list.text:
After finishing the Yasuda Kinen with an 
honorable placement, King Halo receives 
cheers from the crowd.
Everyone is utterly 
enchanted by the "King."

With the results to back up her talent in 
sprints,
King Halo is walking her own path 
as a truly "first-rate Uma Musume."

Smiling as she interacted with her fans, 
she announced that her next destination 
would be the autumn G1 race,
the Sprinters 
Stakes.
